# m.forex.snapshots

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The current state of currency pairs: today's bar, the last minute, and the last quote.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.forex.snapshots(symbols)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`
- `poll(interval, mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `Symbol` and `Updated`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Currency pairs as Massive's tickers, such as `C:EURUSD`, or `dm.ALL` for every pair Massive tracks. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Full Market Snapshot (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read for the dataset's asset class. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. The column is absent when `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `DayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `DayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `DayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `DayClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `DayVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `DayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this ticker. Forex daily bars follow the UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair market value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). |
| `LastQuoteBidPrice` | double | The bid price. From the `lastQuote` object: The most recent quote for this ticker. |
| `LastQuoteAskPrice` | double | The ask price. From the `lastQuote` object: The most recent quote for this ticker. |
| `LastQuoteParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The millisecond accuracy timestamp of the quote. From the `lastQuote` object: The most recent quote for this ticker. |
| `LastQuoteExchange` | long | The exchange ID on which this quote happened. From the `lastQuote` object: The most recent quote for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteTransactions` | long | The number of transactions in the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `LastMinuteWindowStart` | Instant | The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window. From the `min` object: The most recent minute bar for this ticker. |
| `PrevDayOpen` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `PrevDayHigh` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `PrevDayLow` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `PrevDayClose` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `PrevDayVolume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `PrevDayVwap` | double | The volume weighted average price. From the `prevDay` object: The previous day's bar for this ticker, covering the previous UTC day (00:00 to 23:59 UTC). |
| `TodaysChange` | double | The value of the change from the previous day. |
| `TodaysChangePerc` | double | The percentage change since the previous day. |
| `Updated` | Instant | The last updated timestamp. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together, in one REST page, share it. It isn't Massive's time, and it isn't monotonic. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
